description: This file defines the ReadableProduct class, which extends ProductEntity and implements Serializable. It encapsulates product details such as description, pricing, images, manufacturer, and attributes within the sales manager web application.

classes.name: ReadableProduct
classes.description: A class representing a product with attributes like description, price, images, manufacturer, and additional product attributes.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Returns the final price of the product.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price of the product.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Returns the original price before discount.

methods.name: setOriginalPrice
methods.description: Sets the original price before discount.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Checks if the product is discounted.

methods.name: setDiscounted
methods.description: Sets whether the product is discounted.

methods.name: setImages
methods.description: Sets the list of product images.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns the list of product images.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of product attributes.

methods.name: setManufacturer
methods.description: Sets the manufacturer of the product.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer of the product.
